reconciliation: All 55 database settings have explicit API registry categories.
All six environment templates are checked, including the generated API and standalone indexer examples.
Later request-presentation settings follow the approved Administration Settings amendment; original phase evidence remains historical.
SSL_CERT_FILE is optional process TLS infrastructure; public certificates use platform trust.
WEBUI_FULL_TEXT_SEARCH_ENABLED is removed; API FULL_TEXT_SEARCH_ENABLED is the only authority.
MESSAGING_* retains its separately approved deployment ownership.
CONTENT_DOWNLOAD_DB_BATCH_SIZE has no current consumer/template; no unused setting was invented.
PATH is host runtime infrastructure, not a Wathiq product setting.
DATABASE_DISPLAY_NAME_<LANGUAGE> covers localized deployment display names.
Third-party library/internal process variables and test-only seams are not product-setting inventory.
